$comment: Single source for diagram rendering settings used by scripts/render_diagrams.py (M10-01-T09). diagram_font_family is checked against the design engine's ai-slop-banned-fonts.json at render time; the final diagram typography standard is set by AR-12 in M10-07.

gantt.$comment: Gantt settings (M10-13 follow-up). Mermaid otherwise draws a Gantt chart as wide as the renderer's 4,000 px viewport, so labels print far below 8 pt at the 6.25 in body measure. useWidth 720 px with 13 px labels prints the smallest label at 13 x 450 / 720 = 8.1 pt. Colours map Gantt roles to the neutral document tokens in chwezi-design-engine diagram-visual-standards.md section 3a (Ink #1A1A1A, Muted #5A5A5A, rule #D8D8D8, tints #F4F4F4 / #F7F7F7); critical work is shown by a darker tint plus the heavier Ink border, never by Mermaid's red default.
